data: Microsoft's revenue was **$211,915 million in fiscal 2023** and **$281,724 million in fiscal 2025**, both for years ended June 30. That is an increase of $69,809 million, or about **32.9%** over the two years, according to the income statement in the company's fiscal 2025 Form 10-K (filed July 30, 2025). Fiscal 2024 revenue of $245,122 million sat in between. Most of the growth came from Service and Other revenue, which rose from $147,216 million to $217,778 million. Product revenue was roughly flat, moving from $64,699 million to $63,946 million.
